summary: The input is a 4n-1 lattice grid: 3x3 cells separated by solid color-4 lines, cells filled with 0/1 noise, plus one marker — an 8x8 box with 4-walls whose 6x6 interior holds a 2x-upscaled key bitmap (th x tw cells, th/tw in 2..3, spanning its box) in the unique non-{0,1,4} color, off-key interior cleared to 0. The rule recovers the key by halving the marker bbox, then for every 4-aligned lattice cell whose 1-cells contain the key bitmap at the same offsets, recolors those 1-cells to the marker color.
